He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.

22:57.text: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.

22:58.text: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.

22:59.text: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.

22:60.text: with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

22:62.text: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.

22:63.text: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle

22:64.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
